how: Both ways (Rule 130): spec_to_design_check.py (PRD words the design does not show) plus every menu, dialog, tooltip, toast, empty state, label (letter case, L-04) and look compared by hand, design -> PRD and PRD -> design. Outcomes: QUESTION-READY (drafted, not sent: does not close a row) · SETTLED-BY-PRD (a named PRD v3 sentence decides it; no question) · PO-RULED · DESIGN-SILENT (no board draws that state).

differences.board: Main.dc.html (page 1) and every Credit Terms page board (pages 2, 3, 4)
differences.picture: images/ct-p1-02-info-tooltip-due-on-receipt.png (the info icon's tooltip, drawn open); the same words are the icon's hover text on every page board
differences.design_words: Payment is due on the invoice date, but you can create the invoice without taking payment.
differences.prd_words: Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment.
differences.prd_code: S1-R8; §8 row "Hover the info icon on Due on Receipt"
differences.question: NEW-QUESTIONS.py question 1 (drafted 23 Oct 2026, not sent: the QA lead sends it)
differences.held_case: Design-version case planned: DV-01 (AUTOMATION: HOLD - the design differs from the PRD, waiting on the PO)
differences.note: The PRD case quotes S1-R8 and names this difference under References from Design. Not settled by 'latest wins': the canvas version id 1792722751 reads as 2026-10-23 02:32 UTC, later than PRD v3 (2026-10-22 17:25 UTC), if it is a time stamp; that is not certain.

differences.prd_code: S1-N2; §8 row "Inactive tab is empty" ("Inline line in place of the table")
differences.question: NEW-QUESTIONS.py question 2 (not sent)
differences.note: Words match; only whether the column headings stay is different. The PRD case checks the line and the 0 count and names this difference.

differences.design_words: No sentence shows while a field is invalid.
differences.prd_words: While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term ... The line updates as the user types and disappears while the number is invalid. (With the Name empty, "{Name}" reads "This term".)
differences.question: NEW-QUESTIONS.py question 3 (not sent)
differences.held_case: Design-version case planned: DV-03 (held): Name invalid (e.g. a standard term's name) with a valid number shows no blue line
differences.note: The picture itself cannot decide it: both the Name and the Days box are invalid in it. Under the PRD the line depends on the number only.

differences.design_words: Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed; the Name field is never red when the window opens.
differences.prd_words: The Name is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave the field) or presses Create / Save. Opening the window, or clicking an option or a box before typing a name, never shows a Name error.
differences.prd_code: S3-R10 (and S3-R11: the chosen box re-checks on every change)
differences.question: NEW-QUESTIONS.py question 4 (not sent)
differences.held_case: Design-version case planned: DV-04 (held): click into Name, type nothing, click away: "Enter a name." shows
differences.note: "touched" can mean clicked in and out without typing; under the PRD that never shows the Name error.

Build captures on the same boards: another font; table headings bold black; Cancel a grey filled button; × blue; Move To a filled select with a solid caret; ticked boxes solid blue with a white tick.
differences.prd_words: (The PRD does not describe these looks. Every board caption says "layout, wording and states match the build".)

The design library itself (components.css) says checked boxes use a tinted fill, not solid, and that tabs are pills with counts in brackets; the boards' tabs follow production's Inspection Templates tabs instead (caption of page 1 figure 1).

differences.note: Design cases must not ask the tester to compare the card's credit limit on these pictures.
